_note: Single source of truth for Poto colours, spacing and type. Edit here, then run: python3 assets-src/theme/build_theme.py. Entries marked (added) are not in the plan's Section 4; they were needed and are Cody's to change.

fixed._note: (added) Same in light and dark. Photos and photo paper never change with the theme.

space._note: 4-pt grid. Screen edge margin is s5 (20) or more.

radius._note: (added) Paper has barely-rounded corners; controls are round.

type._note: Sizes in pt. family values are roles; the font files are chosen in LICENSES.md.

tracking._note: em. Mono caption lines are spaced out and uppercase.
